messages:
Emma: Heads up — CI failed a DAST run on the nightly pipeline for /v1/upload. DAST flagged a reflected-XSS but SAST is clean.
Emma: Error in scanner logs looks like it couldn't decrypt the build artifact, so it ran with fallback headers and produced noisy findings. snippet: `KMS error: AccessDenied; key=alias/ci-artifact-key`
Emma: Is it safe to grant the scanner ephemeral decrypt rights on that CMK or should we change the artifact flow? :thinking:
Raj: Can you paste the exact log lines and the scanner job id?
Emma: job: `nightly-dast-2026-03-20-14`
Emma: log: `2026-03-20T14:22:11Z ERROR scanner: KMSDeniedDecrypt principal=scan-service-role key=alias/ci-artifact-key requestId=xyz123`
Oliver: That pattern usually produces false positives — the scanner couldn't read the JS bundle so it hit a fallback page. We should avoid giving long-lived decrypt perms.
Marie: Agreed. We should prefer a short-lived grant or create an artifact pre-signed blob that the scanner can fetch without decrypting the CMK.
Raj: Two immediate options: 1) create an AWS KMS Grant scoped to the scanner role (can be retired programmatically), or 2) change CI to upload a pre-signed S3 URL for the scanner step.
Raj: For 1) example flow: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/ci-artifact-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/scan-service-role --operations Decrypt` then retire after the job with `aws kms retire-grant`.
Emma: If we do grants, will we get audit logs that show decrypts? Compliance wants an auditable trail.
Marie: Yes — CloudTrail will record the KMS:Decrypt API calls if the grant results in KMS service activity. You should also see entries like: `EventName=Decrypt, userIdentity=scan-service-role, requestParameters.keyId=alias/ci-artifact-key`.
Oliver: Important: CreateGrant causes the decrypt to appear under the grantee principal in logs. But if you use envelope encryption where the CMK only unwraps a data key, you'll see Unwrap/GenerateDataKey calls. Either way, CloudTrail/audit will capture it.
Emma: Cool. Any RBAC changes needed besides granting the role the KMS ops? The scanner runs as a service role attached to the ephemeral runner.
Raj: Only the IAM principal needs permission in the KMS key policy or via a grant. Key policy is stricter — prefer grants for short-lived access. Grants let us avoid touching key policy and are easier to retire.
Marie: Also add a condition so the grant only allows Decrypt when request originates from the CI VPC or job role: `Condition: { \"StringEquals\": { \"aws:SourceVpce\": \"vpce-0abc123\" } }` or `aws:RequestTag/scan_job=nightly`.
Emma: Good call. Security wants a fallback plan if the grant gets orphaned. Any automation for retiring grants?
Oliver: We can retire grants via a small Lambda that listens to CI job completion events (or a post-job cleanup step). It needs permission `kms:RetireGrant` and to store the grantId returned from create-grant.
security-bot: Deployment note: nightly-dast-2026-03-20-14 started at 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z and failed at 2026-03-20T14:22:11Z (scan-job-id=nightly-dast-2026-03-20-14).
Emma: For the immediate unblock, can we run a one-off change: create-grant, run scanner, retire-grant, and post the grantId here? I'll coordinate with infra. :+1:
Raj: Yep. If you want me to own it I can run the create/retire steps — ping me when the job is ready. I’ll also add a short retention note to the ticket.
Emma: ping Raj — please do. Also tagging oncall: @sre-oncall — can you watch for any unusual KMS or key-rotation alerts during the window?
sre-oncall: I’m on it. Will watch CloudTrail and alert if we see >3 Decrypts from unexpected principals in 5m.
Emma: After this, let's file a follow-up to switch to pre-signed artifact URLs for DAST to avoid KMS perms entirely. Low effort, high ROI.
Marie: +1 for presigned URLs and least privilege. We should also update the Secure SDLC checklist to require scanner artifact access patterns that don't require CMK decrypts.
Oliver: I'll draft the checklist change and a short runbook for ephemeral grants (create -> run -> retire -> verify audit logs).
Emma: Thanks all. Raj, once you create the grant, drop the `grantId` and the retire log here.
Raj: Will do, next message will be the `grantId` and retirement confirmation.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered: nightly-dast-2026-03-20-14 (rerun by Raj)
Raj: Grant created: `grantId=abcde-12345-grant` (created at 2026-03-20T14:30:05Z). Running scanner now.
Raj: Grant retired: `retireGrantId=abcde-12345-grant` (retired at 2026-03-20T14:32:20Z). Audit sample: `2026-03-20T14:31:12Z CloudTrail Event: Decrypt principal=arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/scan-service-role keyId=alias/ci-artifact-key requestId=xyz789`
Emma: Verified CI now produced same pack and DAST findings are gone. Closing this thread. Will open a ticket to migrate to presigned artifact flow. :white_check_mark:
